Why SELLO Retail

The problem

Busy shops need billing that is fast at the counter, stock that stays accurate, and credit customers who are easy to follow up — without paying a monthly cloud fee or stopping when the internet drops.

Our solution

SELLO Retail runs on the counter PC, a tablet or a phone, with an encrypted database on the device. Billing, stock, purchases, customers, installments, ledgers, shifts and reports all work offline, in English, Arabic or Hindi, with the right tax for India, the UAE or Saudi Arabia.

From one counter to many shops

Start with one counter. Add SELLO Back Office when the shop has several counters, and SELLO Head Office when you open more shops — every counter keeps billing on its own, even when the network is down.

Which setup do you need?

01

One counter

SELLO Retail

  • Billing, stock, customers and reports on one PC, tablet or phone
  • Works 100% offline
02

One shop, several counters

SELLO Retail + SELLO Back Office

  • Every counter’s dashboard, bills, stock, shifts and audit log on one PC
  • Change products, prices, users, roles and bill design for one or all counters
  • Stores: the counters of a shop share one product list and one stock
  • Salaries and payroll, profit and expenses, automatic email reports
03

Several shops

+ SELLO Head Office

  • All shops added up, or one shop or counter at a time
  • Sales today, shops online, reports, profit and salaries
  • The audit log of every counter in every shop
  • Look-only users for senior accountants
  • Over the internet — no VPN or network settings

Offline edition: SELLO Retail and Back Office on the shop network. Online edition: adds Head Office over the internet. If the connection drops, nothing stops — changes wait at the shop and go up later, in order.

How it works

  1. Step 1

    Install SELLO Retail on the counter PC, tablet or phone — each starts with a 7-day free trial.

  2. Step 2

    Set up the shop: country and tax, products (or import them from Excel), printers and users.

  3. Step 3

    Bill at the counter: scan, take payment and print or share the bill, with the customer display showing the total.

  4. Step 4

    Close each shift with its report, follow up credit and installments, and check the dashboard and reports.

// 09

Under the hood

Technical overview

Flutter app for Windows, Android and iOS with an encrypted SQLite database (SQLCipher) on the device. Money is stored in the smallest currency unit and tax is rounded per line by country. Prints to 58 / 80 mm thermal printers over USB, Bluetooth or network, and A4. Supplier-bill scanning reads text on the device without internet. SELLO Back Office (Windows) pairs each counter with a one-time code over the shop network; SELLO Head Office (Windows) pairs each Back Office and syncs over the internet. Licensed by activation codes: 7-day trial, then 1, 2, 3 or 5-year plans.

Data & privacy

Shop, sales and customer data is stored encrypted on your own device, and on your Back Office PC with a separate key for each counter. With Head Office, changes pass through SELLO’s cloud only until your Head Office has collected them. Backup and restore to a file is built in.

// 10

FAQ

Does SELLO Retail need the internet?

No. Billing, stock, customers and reports all work offline on the device. Only SELLO Head Office, for owners with several shops, uses the internet.

Can I run several counters and several shops?

Yes. The counters in a shop connect to SELLO Back Office on one PC over the shop network, and SELLO Head Office shows the owner every shop over the internet.

What if the network or internet goes down?

Billing never stops. Each counter keeps working and sends its changes later, in order.

Does it have CRM, quotations and invoices?

Yes. Leads, follow-ups, quotations, A4 tax invoices, delivery notes, recurring invoices, credit notes, receipts and payment vouchers — in your own invoice design.

Which devices does it run on?

Windows PCs, Android tablets and phones, and iPad / iPhone (iOS).

Can bills be sent to customers on WhatsApp?

Yes. Turn on auto-send and every bill goes to the customer’s WhatsApp as a PDF after the sale — or send any bill with one tap.

Can the owner get reports by email?

Yes. Schedule a daily summary at the time you choose; shift reports are emailed automatically too.

Can I print barcode and QR labels?

Yes. Generate barcodes for products that have none and print barcode or QR code labels.

Can I add many products at once?

Yes. Import products in bulk from Excel or CSV, and edit prices and other fields for many products at once.

Does it support GST and VAT?

Yes — India GST (CGST, SGST, IGST), UAE VAT and Saudi VAT, with tax-inclusive or exclusive prices.

Can I sell on installments?

Yes. Set a down payment and installments with due dates; SELLO Retail tracks what is paid, due and overdue.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. Every install starts with a 7-day free trial; after that, an activation code unlocks a 1, 2, 3 or 5-year plan.

Do you supply POS hardware too?

Yes. We supply complete POS systems — terminals, tablets, printers, scanners and cash drawers — with SELLO Retail installed.
